question: Does any existing portal read return a firm's ADVISORS WITH THEIR EMAIL (the input the Ticket Center needs for advisor_email on an on-behalf upload)?
verdict_basis: No read at base returns an advisor identity with an email for a firm. The Investor Reporting directory reads return firm, client, relationship and account entries; the firm chooser returns firms; the resolve-scope owner carries an advisor_id (an identifier, not a list, no email). The only email read on the Investor Reporting page is the signed-in user's own.

searched.what: document() and readDirectoryBrowse() accept only the closed DirectoryEntry key set above; no advisor or email key is admitted

searched.lines: 1242-1250 (searchDirectory, operation directory-search); 1252-1268 (browseDirectory, operation directory-browse); 1270-1289 (resolveScope and resolveDirectoryContext, operation resolve-scope)
searched.what: each returns DirectoryEntry lists, a DirectoryBrowsePage, or a ResolvedScope; none returns an advisor list
resolved.owner.advisor_id: string or null (an identifier on a composed request, not a directory list, no email)
DirectoryContext firms carry tenant, state, scope, reason; no advisor member
loadAllowedFirms (the firm chooser) reads the Global context READY firms (id, label) for staff, or permittedFirms (id, label) for a firm caller. It returns firms only.
answersRefusal requires a typed advisor name; the upload call is uploadAnalysisInput(input.upload, input.answers.firm) with no advisor argument
the Advisor input is free text (aria-label Advisor, placeholder Advisor (required))
AnalysisRequestAnswers.advisor: string (a typed name for the report)
TradeUser {email, name, role, active, groups} and TradeUserMe: the trade-approval user record, not a firm's advisor list; no firm key
platinum/advisors reads return advisor_id and advisor_name only (for example advisor_name at 585 and 966); the file holds no email member
the only email read on the page: auth.user email for the signed-in user (not a directory)

negative_searches.note: FIRM_EMAIL_DOMAINS and isEmailFromFirm (domain test on an email, lines 174-208); no advisor list, no directory read
portfolio.ts 91 and 247, tickets.ts 61, 146, 180, trade-submission.ts 76-163, 259-411; none is a firm advisor directory; none in advisor-intelligence.ts or investor-reporting.ts
RequestList.tsx and OwnedRequestHistory.tsx (prose only), index.tsx (signed-in user), and four tests

not_read: The live directory rows for 49financial (no live call was made: the order is WORLD-read-only and the stop is at the source read).
Whether the gateway forwards any query member to the upload door (no live call).
The rendered Ticket Center page (no browser run).
The backend door's advisor directory (infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting, served.py _advisor_owner): not in the portal tree; the order bounds reads to the portal.
decision: BLOCKING. No existing portal read returns a firm's advisors with their email. Per AR-y-377 step 1, the build is STOPPED and no picker, no advisor_email member, no test file and no candidate branch were made. A BLOCKING surprise row is filed for the issuer to cut a backend cell.
